i1.title: Britney Spears Fantasy Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
A sweeter, deeper take on the cult Fantasy.

Britney Spears Fantasy Intense Eau de Parfum 100ml is a fruity floral gourmand for women, launched in 2021. Juicy pear, red lychee and kiwi open bright and playful, a frosted cupcake accord with white chocolate orchid and jasmine forms the heart, and it settles into a creamy base of patchouli, tonka bean and sandalwood.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Pear, Red Lychee, Kiwi
  • Heart: Cupcake Accord, White Chocolate Orchid, Jasmine
  • Base: Patchouli, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood

Key details

  • Brand: Britney Spears
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Fruity · Floral · Gourmand
  • Wear: Women

Why you'll love it

  • A juicy pear, lychee and kiwi opening
  • A sweet cupcake and white chocolate orchid heart
  • A creamy patchouli, tonka and sandalwood base
  • Great value 100ml Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does Fantasy Intense smell like?

Pear, red lychee and kiwi first, then cupcake accord, white chocolate orchid and jasmine, finishing with patchouli, tonka bean and sandalwood.

Is it for women?

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.
